title: Phase 10: Tests (~500 LOC)
description:

Phase 10 adds the remaining cross-phase and corner-case tests:

title: Phase 8: Emitter (~120 LOC)
description:
Entry: Phase 7 complete.

Implementation: src/emitter.rs
- Output format routing: text (plain string to stdout), json (JSON object with result/cost/session_id/claude_version), stream-json (forward raw JSONL lines as written)
- claude_version: read from child process version string captured at startup
- Error result objects: exit code mapping (0=success, 1=error, 2=no-response, 3=timeout, 4=input-error)
- stream-json: reader thread consuming JSONL transcript file via mpsc channel, forward each line to stdout as written

Complete when:
- All emitter unit tests pass (tests/emitter.rs)
- AS-1 (text output format) passes: response text emitted to stdout, exit 0
- AS-2 (json output format) passes: valid JSON object on stdout with result field
- stream-json output parses as valid JSONL (each line is valid JSON)

title: Add PTY integration tests: startup and exit-path scenarios
description:
Expand tests/pty_integration.rs with mock-PTY tests for the following scenarios from the plan's integration test table:

- Happy path: exit 0, correct response text, non-zero token counts
- Trust dialog (standard wording): MOCK_TRUST_DIALOG=1 → exit 0
- Trust dialog (alternate wording): MOCK_TRUST_DIALOG=1 MOCK_TRUST_WORDING=alternate → exit 0
- No startup output: MOCK_SILENT=1 → exit 2 after timeout
- Child exits before Stop: MOCK_EXIT_BEFORE_STOP=1 → exit 2
- Stop hook never fires: MOCK_DELAY_STOP=99999 → exit 124
- Stop fires before PROMPT_INJECTED: MOCK_STOP_BEFORE_INJECT=1 → exit 2, is_error=true in output (EC-7)

Each test invokes the compiled claude-print binary with --claude-binary pointing at the mock-claude test fixture. Use std::process::Command to invoke the binary under test.

Acceptance criteria:
- All 7 tests compile and pass via cargo test
- Each test asserts the correct exit code
- Happy path test also asserts non-empty response text in stdout

- Running install.sh on a clean system installs the binary and exits 0
- claude-print --check succeeds after install

title: Add PTY integration tests: output formats, multi-turn, and missing-data fallbacks
description:
Add PTY-level integration tests (using mock-claude binary) for these scenarios:

- Output format json: parse stdout as JSON, verify all required fields present
- Output format stream-json: each stdout line parses as valid JSON
- Multi-turn: MOCK_TURNS=3 → last turn text returned, 3 turns counted in token sum
- Transcript race: MOCK_DELAY_JSONL=100 → retry loop fires, exit 0
- Missing transcript_path: MOCK_OMIT_TRANSCRIPT_PATH=1 → path derived, exit 0
- Missing last_assistant_message: MOCK_OMIT_LAST_MESSAGE=1 → retry-only path, exit 0
- Both omitted + delayed JSONL: MOCK_OMIT_LAST_MESSAGE=1 MOCK_DELAY_JSONL=200 → retries suffice, exit 0
- Error in transcript: MOCK_IS_ERROR=1 → exit 1, is_error=true in json output
- Custom response text: MOCK_RESPONSE=hello → response field equals 'hello' in json output
- Large prompt (>32KB): test harness sends 33000-byte stdin → file relay used, exit 0

Depends on: bf-3pc (startup/exit-path scenarios must be written first so the PTY test helpers are established)

Acceptance criteria:
- All 10 tests compile and pass via cargo test
- SIGINT test added: send SIGINT to process after 1s with MOCK_DELAY_STOP=5000, assert exit 130

title: Phase 7: Transcript Reader (~180 LOC)
description:
Entry: Phase 6 complete. PO-5 acknowledged: retry loop (40×50ms) is the mitigation for Stop-before-JSONL races. Verify retry timing by running test_transcript_race with MOCK_DELAY_JSONL=100 and confirming exit 0.

Implementation: src/transcript.rs
- JSONL parse with lenient serde (unknown fields tolerated, unknown event types skipped)
- message.id dedup + usage-fingerprint fallback dedup for events without message.id
- Text extraction from assistant ContentBlock array (text type only)
- 40×50ms retry loop with Stop-payload fallback to last_assistant_message after exhausted
- Path derivation: strip leading /, replace / with -, append session_id from Stop payload

Complete when:
- All transcript unit tests pass (tests/transcript.rs)
- test_streaming_dedup_40_retries passes
- AS-6 (race scenario: Stop fires before JSONL flush) passes with MOCK_DELAY_JSONL=100

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 7

title: Phase 6: Stop Poller (~80 LOC)
description:

Implementation: poller.rs (or extend event_loop.rs)
- Open FIFO read-end O_NONBLOCK, integrate into poll() loop
- Parse Stop hook JSON payload (session_id, transcript_path, last_assistant_message)
- Derive transcript path from session_id + cwd slug if transcript_path absent
- Signal event loop exit via channel/flag

Complete when:
- Integration test test_stop_hook_fires passes (mock_claude emits Stop, FIFO received, exit 0)
- test_missing_transcript_path_derived passes (Stop without transcript_path → path derived from session_id)

Reference: docs/plan/plan.md § Phase 6

title: Add PTY integration tests: version resilience and --no-inherit-hooks
description:
Add remaining PTY-level integration tests using mock-claude binary:

Version-resilience PTY scenarios:
- Unknown probe emitted: MOCK_UNKNOWN_PROBE=1 → probe ignored, session completes, exit 0
- Unknown event type in JSONL: MOCK_UNKNOWN_EVENT_TYPE=1 → parse succeeds, text extracted, exit 0
- Unknown usage fields: MOCK_UNKNOWN_USAGE_FIELDS=1 → ignored, token counts correct, exit 0

Hook inheritance scenarios (PTY-level, invoking claude-print binary):
- --no-inherit-hooks flag: the appropriate --setting-sources argument appears in mock-claude's received argv (either --setting-sources= or --setting-sources=none), exit 0
- Without --no-inherit-hooks: --setting-sources is absent from child argv, exit 0
- Verify --settings <temp>/settings.json is always present in child argv in both modes

Conformance harness (PTY-level):
- test_output_format_wire_compat: run claude-print --output-format json with mock-claude, verify all fields from the claude -p wire format are present, is_error=false, type=result, usage fields are integers
- claude_version extra field does not cause parse failure with deny_unknown_fields strict struct

Depends on: bf-4nq

Acceptance criteria:
- All tests compile and pass via cargo test
- INV-1 verified in at least one test: after each test assert no claude-print-* dirs remain in TMPDIR
